data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 16.0 million, (2014: GBP 18.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance. prior_year_events.impact_description: The RITC increased ultimate claims for earlier underwriting years (notably a large increase between three and four years later for the 2011 underwriting year) following the assumed reserves from other syndicates.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small prior-year release of gross claims provisions in 2015: the technical provisions note shows a gross 'change in prior year provisions' of -GBP 8.228m (a release, c. -2.7% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 308.138m). The report also describes net favourable prior-year movements of GBP 16.0m (net of reinsurance). The release was driven by favourable claims development across several classes (notably marine, third party liability, fire and accident & health) and was influenced by reinsurance items including incoming RITC arrangements which materially affected certain older underwriting years (notably 2011).
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 16.0 million (2014: GBP 18.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
The overall movement in net claims provisions is stated after taking into account the impact of incoming RITC and quota share portfolios.
The large increase in ultimate claims between three and four years later for the 2011 pure underwriting year is predominantly due to the RITC's of syndicates 1965 and 2243 in 2015.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Statement of Financial Position - Technical provisions, prior year comparative column). Prior year development taken from 'Change in prior year provisions' gross line in Technical Provisions note (explicit gross GBP 8,228k release). The report also states net prior-year favourable movement of GBP 16.0m (net of reinsurance) and class-level movements shown in Claims note are net of reinsurance - those per-class figures are therefore NET amounts (used for LOB movement indications only). A significant incoming RITC is present (RITC of syndicates 1965 and 2243) which affects comparability and the claims development triangle. Gross claims-development table is sparse and contains '2010 and prior' aggregate column which was excluded from triangle calculations.
